recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光（AP erect）：兩側下肺野呈均質不透亮陰影、肋膈角變鈍、左側橫膈輪廓被遮蔽，符合兩側肋膜積液；這是影像而非形態學圖片。
features: Bilateral dependent homogeneous basal opacities with blunting of the costophrenic angles
Left hemidiaphragm silhouette obscured; right basal opacity with a meniscus-like upper margin
Cardiomediastinal silhouette partly obscured by the basal opacities
No morphologic (cytologic) information; etiology of effusion cannot be determined from the image
describe_en: Anteroposterior erect chest radiograph shows bilateral homogeneous opacities at the lung bases with blunting of both costophrenic angles and obscuration of the left hemidiaphragm, consistent with bilateral pleural effusions. The aerated upper and mid lung zones show no discrete mass on this single view. The radiograph cannot establish the cause of the effusions; in a patient with plasma cell myeloma, thoracentesis with cytology (cytospin for plasma cells), flow cytometry, or cell block immunostains is required to distinguish myelomatous effusion from cardiac, renal, infectious, or amyloid-related causes. Findings are consistent with bilateral pleural effusions.
